step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture is extracted by analyzing clients (mobile, web, and focus camera) uploading content to S3 and registering jobs in SQS. Custom scaling is handled by a Lambda function reading metrics from CloudWatch and SQS, then scaling a Spot Fleet of EC2 instances. The EC2 instances process the transcoding jobs and write output back to S3.

graph.name: Huddle Video Transcoding Architecture
graph.notes: Cost-effective, highly scalable video ingestion and transcoding system using Spot Fleet, Lambda, SQS, and S3.
